'''Matt Hankinson''' of Ann Arbor, Michigan, was the first of 1,177 correct entries for Puzzle 3 of the 1997 Dagobah Contest, [[Shut Him Up Or Shut Him Down]]. He won a display box of white-border Premiere packs.<ref name="sol3">[http://rothko.decipher.com/new/dagobahcontest/solution3.html The Dagobah Contest], Decipher (March 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970327214407/http://rothko.decipher.com/new/dagobahcontest/solution3.html Internet Archive]</ref>
